text:
Lena Sales: Quick pass to CS for "Orion Lite" (trial). Tenant: orion-lite-2025. Goal: basic API trial, internal demo next week. Renewal horizon ~45 days. No SSO yet. Billing contact TBD. Link to signup notes: https://drive.redwood/orion-lite-brief.

Marco CS: Thanks @Lena. I can take point on onboarding and the 30d renewal watch.
- Plan: async welcome + 1x 15m walkthrough, sample prompts, and a one-pager.
- Capture in C360 after kickoff.

Priya Support: I'll own provisioning + support triage. Opening ticket SUP-5810. Need org id, region preference, and any demo datasets.

Lena Sales: Org id: orion-L-55. Region: us-east-1. Demo dataset: small_product_feed.csv (shared in drive).

Priya Support: Running provision now. Script we use:
```
POST /admin/provision
{
  "tenant":"orion-lite-2025",
  "org":"orion-L-55",
  "env":"trial",
  "region":"us-east-1"
}
```
Will paste results.

Ethan Eng: Ping me if you see KV cache misses or cold-start > 600ms during demo. I recommend `gpt-lite-v2-quant` for trial to save cost.

Marco CS: expected demo QPS ~1.5, avg 0.3, typical session < 120 tokens. Sounds fine.

Priya Support: Provision completed ✅. Endpoint: https://orion-lite-2025.api.redwood/v1, API key masked `rk_test_orion_xxx`. Smoke test: prompt->completion OK, sample dataset uploaded. Ticket SUP-5810 updated.

Ethan Eng: Thx. I'll deploy an autoscale tweak (min_capacity 0.3 gpu-equivalent) and add a simple per-route latency alert.

Marco CS: please do Ethan. That should keep demo stable. I'll record a 8-10m demo and drop a short checklist: 1) How to call API 2) Example prompts 3) Where to find logs 4) Who to contact for billing.

Lena Sales: I'll connect billing contact (cc'd on kickoff) and schedule kickoff call for Mon 2025-03-17 11:00 PT.

ReminderBot: Event created: Kickoff - Orion Lite (2025-03-17T11:00:00-07:00).

Marco CS: Owners & next steps:
- Priya: provisioning & support triage (SUP-5810) — done
- Ethan: autoscale & latency dashboard — in progress
- Marco: walkthrough + C360 notes + 30d renewal nudges
- Lena: billing contact + kickoff scheduling

Lena Sales: Renewal risk set to "watch" (no immediate blocker). Note: customer asked for SSO timeline during kickoff; finance might push on SSO before renewal.

Priya Support: Closing SUP-5810 for now, will reopen on new issues. Added runbook snippet to ticket with smoke test results.

Marco CS: Captured customer asks: recorded demo, clearer sample prompts, SSO timeline. I'll put these into C360 and add follow-up tasks after kickoff.

Ethan Eng: Dropped autoscale patch and a basic per-route latency panel. Patch ref: INF-ORL-092.

Marco CS: Great, I'll follow up post-kickoff with the one-pager and assign a renewal owner at 30d.

Lena Sales: Thanks team, closing the pass. 👍
